categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen CDL Precision Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the consumer electronics industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of functional and structural components for consumer electronics. Key product lines include thermal dissipation, conductive shielding, cushioning sealing functional components, PMMA+PC composite material phone backplates, glass fiber composite phone backplates, precision optical components, wearable device components, and new energy vehicle battery pack components. The company serves smart phones, smart wearables, tablets, smart home devices, and new energy vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including multi-layer stacking die-cutting of thin materials, laser cutting, CNC precision engraving, slitting, color collision printing, texture design and transfer printing, PVD, NCVM, thermoforming, surface hardening, automated injection molding, spraying, and assembly. It integrates digital factory concepts, intelligent manufacturing, numerical control, and automation to enhance production efficiency and product quality. R&D focuses on innovative composite materials, optical components, and wearable device technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global consumer electronics brands such as Samsung, OPPO, vivo, Google, and Sharp. Its products are widely applied in smart phones, tablets, wearable devices, smart home products, and new energy vehicles. The primary market is the communications industry, accounting for over 98% of revenue, with a growing presence in other industries including automotive and emerging sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and production facilities are located in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Huizhou in China, as well as overseas in Vietnam and South Korea. The company has a global production layout to better serve worldwide customers and meet regional market demands. Domestic sales account for approximately 70% of revenue, with the remainder from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the consumer electronics supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying functional and structural components to downstream device manufacturers. It engages in upstream procurement of raw materials and molds but does not operate in raw material extraction or final product retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technological innovation and efficiency optimization, focusing on R&D in smart wearables (smart watches, rings, glasses), AI integration, and composite materials development (transitioning from PMMA+PC to glass fiber, carbon fiber, and PEEK composites). It aims to enhance product differentiation through personalized design and expand market share by developing new products with proprietary technologies. R&D investment remains significant, with a growing and highly educated technical team.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized functional and structural electronic components to major consumer electronics manufacturers. The company follows a direct sales model with a three-stage supplier qualification process and offers flexible credit terms to customers. Product sales constitute the majority of revenue, with a small portion from other business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds an important position in the consumer electronics components industry, supplying to top-tier global brands. While specific competitors are not named, the company competes in a highly competitive market with intense price competition and technological advancement pressures. It leverages its technological innovation, quality, and global production capacity to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.54 billion, representing an 11.21% increase over the previous year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 155 million, the loss narrowed by 39.02% compared to 2023. The company has total assets of around RMB 2.13 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.04 billion. Cash flow from operating activities improved significantly, indicating better liquidity and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective customized components with advanced manufacturing technologies and rapid market responsiveness. Its value proposition includes strong R&D capabilities, global production layout, and close collaboration with leading consumer electronics brands to deliver innovative, functional, and structural components that enhance end-product performance and user experience. The focus on AI integration and composite material innovation further differentiates its offerings.
